verdict.rationale: The axis applies: AI Q&A over workspace content is a fair capability for a work-management tool. The pack never documents asking Rovo AI a question and getting a cited answer. Rovo is described only as linking assets to work, spotting trends, building automations and breaking down tasks, and the MCP server is a developer building block, so none of these count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask AI a question and get an instant answer with citations from my workspace content
